response.rationale: OrderLine and Order represent distinct business concepts in a part-whole relationship rather than the same concept under different names. In PlaceOrderUseCase (node 6860bbf1a3b5131d, src/ordering/application/place-order.use-case.ts, line 1, `execute(id: string, customerEmail: string, lines: readonly OrderLine[]): Order {`), a collection of `OrderLine` items (`lines: readonly OrderLine[]`) is passed as input to construct and return a parent `Order`. In OrderNotificationService (node ee110f001f97012a, src/notifications/application/order-notification.service.ts, line 1, `const subtotal = order.subtotal();`), `Order` represents the overall order entity whose aggregate subtotal is calculated via `Order.subtotal`.
